Class WMFGraphics2D

  java.awt.Graphics

                          jsesh.wmfexport.WMFGraphics2D
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.freehep.graphics2d.VectorGraphicsConstants
public class WMFGraphics2D
extends org.freehep.graphicsio.AbstractVectorGraphicsIO

Windows Metafile Format Graphics 2D driver. IMPORTANT : improve pen handling. Pen should be as shared as possible. Store them in an array, and delete those who don't survive a gc restore.

Author:
S. Rosmorduc
